profile.name: Nathan Kenani
profile.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Versatile Software Development Engineer committed to consistently finding dynamic solutions for software issues. Polished in finding innovative ways to build scalable, high-availability online systems efficiently. Seven-year background in creating and implementing software systems, currently looking for front-end development job opportunities, especially using Angular framework and Java.
profile.introduction: I am an experienced Software Engineer seeking an opportunity at your company. I have a strong track record and am looking forward to bringing my skills and abilities to the team. I am an experienced Software Engineer with demonstrated skills in technical analysis, front-end development, object-oriented programming, and application deployment. I am a dependable asset to the team, always punctual and determined to get the job done. I never waver in my contribution to my team as I am always ready to help out my co-workers to achieve the result. I am a quick study with a dedication to keep learning and improving on what I know. Being highly organized and detail-oriented makes it easier to manage my own time for the success of the team. Please take a look at my enclosed resume for more details about my work experience and qualifications. I'd really like to speak with you more about the position, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.

responsibilities: Developed web applications using a variety of engineering languages. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define features and build powerful and easy-to-use products and customer-facing workflow tools. Wrote, tested, and deployed code, verifying operational and UX integrity for releases.
Conducted full lifecycle software development from planning to deployment and maintenance.
Performed regression and performance tests for updated systems. Tackled development tasks based on system requirements and documented approaches.
Coordinated with project managers to meet development timelines and plan testing.
Liaised with QA testers to perform testing on various parameters. Reviewed and modified unit and integration tests to improve software quality and reliability.
Analyzed solutions and coding fixes for software problems.
Migrated applications from on-premises to the cloud.
Created workflows to update list items, retrieve workflow history, and retrieve, delete, and restore versions of list items.
Provided technical support to end-users and resolved day-to-day issues regarding SharePoint usage.
Tested and debugged code to locate the exact root cause at code levels.
